items.question: What claim is made about the instability of recognizing the Lord over time?
premises: Recognition of the Lord lasts one day.
Awareness alternates between recognition and oblivion.
items.inference: Recognition of the Lord is fleeting and outweighed by periods of forgetfulness.
uncertainties: The exact sense of muṣisa as forgetfulness versus mind is context-dependent.
Whether svāmī addresses an external lord or the inner self is not explicit.
items.plain_english: For one day you are the Lord, but for two nights you remain in forgetfulness.
